<!-- pr-reviewer: 789dfe632b0348a0347707165783e434dba21bf8 -->
**Not built - needs a maintainer look.** Read-only review; no blockers found by reading.

**Why not built:** the PR adds a direct dependency, `png = "0.18"` (workspace `Cargo.toml`, `crates/app/Cargo.toml`). The `Cargo.lock` change is exactly one line: `"png"` added to camcraft-app's dependency list. It adds no new crate to the lock and changes no version, because `png 0.18.1` is already locked through `image`. No other Cargo, build.rs, script or workflow changes. A maintainer should still accept the direct dependency before anything is built.

**What looks good (read)**
- Goes through the app layer only: `mcp/render.rs` uses `stock_sim::simulate_document` and `plan_program`, with no UI coupling.
- Image size is bounded: `width`/`height` 16..2048 are checked in `edge()` (render.rs) and again in `Camera::fit` (raster.rs). The worst case is about 45 MB of buffers. Overlay line walks are capped at the canvas diagonal.
- Refusals are named: bad or unknown arguments (`additionalProperties: false`), no simulation, nothing standing above the floor, no finite extent.
- No `unwrap`/`expect`/`panic` outside tests. Pixel indexing is bounds-checked, non-finite vertices are skipped, and float-to-int casts are clamped.
- Provenance lines are present on both new modules. Each file is under 400 lines. The decision file `docs/decisions/182-mcp-sim-render.md` is included. The body has `Changelog:` and `Fixes #182`. `CHANGELOG.md` is not touched, and no snapshot PNGs or goldens are changed.
- Rendering is deterministic, and the tests check that. base64 is hand-written (about 10 lines) instead of adding a crate.
- `tool_ok` lifts the PNG into an image block, so the base64 is not duplicated in the text or `structuredContent`.
- No overlap with #444 or #456/#422 in the touched lines. `tools.rs` gets one table row, and GitHub reports the PR as MERGEABLE.

**Local results:** not run (dependency change). The author reports `mcp_render` 5/5, `mcp` 9/9 and clippy clean. The remaining batch failures it lists also fail on upstream main.

**Questions / notes (not blocking)**
1. The MCP `instructions` string (`mcp/mod.rs`, around line 153) still lists the flow without `render_stock`. It is discoverable through `tools/list`, so mentioning it is optional.
2. A 2048x2048 PNG is a large single stdio line (about 16 MB at worst). That is probably acceptable after #444, but a maintainer may want to confirm.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- pr-reviewer-build: 789dfe632b0348a0347707165783e434dba21bf8 -->
Build follow-up. The maintainer approved the direct `png = "0.18"` dependency (already in Cargo.lock via `image`), so I built it, trial-merged with current origin/main (clean, no conflicts).

- `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test mcp_render`: 5 passed, 0 failed
- `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test mcp`: 13 passed, 0 failed
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean

No blockers found in the earlier read-only review either. A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
